protocol.candidate: Scan cores of 8, 12, 16, or 20 pictures with five-picture flanks. Require supported phase losses on at least three common sectors and positive before/after agreement in each. Keep one strongest range per arm.
protocol.gate: At least four correctly localized independently aligned redraws across three groups, at least 70% coverage on each main held class, at most two ordinary flags total and none on untouched recordings, H.264 recompression or cuts. Temporal IoU >=0.50.
protocol.measurement: On a rigid eye and lip-corner coordinate system, sample tangential profiles from inner and outer rails of a mouth-centered contour. Compare signed fine-band phase agreement against two off-phase pairings. Subtract a matched outer rail and compare independently to the coarse-band change.
protocol.native: Band-pass filter decoded native luminance before sampling, require all rail points on observed pixels, no synthesis, no alternate file, no authored mask, no audio. Require a verified picture clock and one shot.
protocol.point: Third-largest strictly positive ordinary maximum, or .02 if higher, from the earlier GRID development controls only.
